vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Translate approved examination arrangements into accurate room and staffing schedules.
requirements.zh: 将获批考试安排转化为准确房间及人员排程。

requirements.en: Maintain traceable authorization records and distinguish scheduled sittings from learner counts or attendance.
requirements.zh: 维护可追溯授权记录，并区分计划应考人次、学习者人数及出席情况。

requirements.en: Communicate approved details and escalate unresolved arrangement questions appropriately.
requirements.zh: 沟通获批信息，并适当升级上报未解决安排问题。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently assess learning needs and authorize examination adjustments.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立评估学习需要，并授权考试调整措施。
